record.bible_text: And David<WH01732> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto the LORD<WH03068> the words<WH01697> of this song<WH07892> in the day<WH03117> <FI>that<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> had delivered<WH05337><WTH8689> him out of the hand<WH03709> of all his enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, and out of the hand<WH03709> of Saul<WH07586>:<CM>
And he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, The LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> my rock<WH05553>, and my fortress<WH04686>, and my deliverer<WH06403><WTH8764>;

The God<WH0430> of my rock<WH06697>; in him will I trust<WH02620><WTH8799>: <FI>he is<Fi> my shield<WH04043>, and the horn<WH07161> of my salvation<WH03468>, my high tower<WH04869>, and my refuge<WH04498>, my saviour<WH03467><WTH8688>; thou savest<WH03467><WTH8686> me from violence<WH02555>.
I will call<WH07121><WTH8799> on the LORD<WH03068>, <FI>who is<Fi> worthy to be praised<WH01984><WTH8794>: so shall I be saved<WH03467><WTH8735> from mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>.

When the waves<WH04867> of death<WH04194> compassed<WH0661><WTH8804> me, the floods<WH05158> of ungodly men<WH01100> made me afraid<WH01204><WTH8762>; <RF>waves: or, pangs<Rf> <RF>ungodly...: Heb. Belial<Rf>
The sorrows<WH02256> of hell<WH07585> compassed me about<WH05437><WTH8804>; the snares<WH04170> of death<WH04194> prevented<WH06923><WTH8765> me; <RF>sorrows: or, cords<Rf>

In my distress<WH06862> I called<WH07121><WTH8799> upon the LORD<WH03068>, and cried<WH07121><WTH8799> to my God<WH0430>: and he did hear<WH08085><WTH8799> my voice<WH06963> out of his temple<WH01964>, and my cry<WH07775> <FI>did enter<Fi> into his ears<WH0241>.

Then the earth<WH0776> shook<WH01607><WTH8691><WTH8675><WH01607><WTH8799> and trembled<WH07493><WTH8799>; the foundations<WH04146> of heaven<WH08064> moved<WH07264><WTH8799> and shook<WH01607><WTH8691>, because he was wroth<WH02734><WTH8804>.

There went up<WH05927><WTH8804> a smoke<WH06227> out of his nostrils<WH0639>, and fire<WH0784> out of his mouth<WH06310> devoured<WH0398><WTH8799>: coals<WH01513> were kindled<WH01197><WTH8804> by it. <RF>out of his nostrils: Heb. by, etc<Rf>
He bowed<WH05186><WTH8799> the heavens<WH08064> also, and came down<WH03381><WTH8799>; and darkness<WH06205> <FI>was<Fi> under his feet<WH07272>.
And he rode<WH07392><WTH8799> upon a cherub<WH03742>, and did fly<WH05774><WTH8799>: and he was seen<WH07200><WTH8735> upon the wings<WH03671> of the wind<WH07307>.

And he made<WH07896><WTH8799> darkness<WH02822> pavilions<WH05521> round about<WH05439> him, dark<WH02841> waters<WH04325>, <FI>and<Fi> thick clouds<WH05645> of the skies<WH07834>. <RF>dark...: Heb. binding of waters<Rf>
Through the brightness<WH05051> before him were coals<WH01513> of fire<WH0784> kindled<WH01197><WTH8804>.
The LORD<WH03068> thundered<WH07481><WTH8686> from heaven<WH08064>, and the most High<WH05945> uttered<WH05414><WTH8799> his voice<WH06963>.
And he sent out<WH07971><WTH8799> arrows<WH02671>, and scattered<WH06327><WTH8686> them; lightning<WH01300>, and discomfited<WH02000><WTH8799> them.

And the channels<WH0650> of the sea<WH03220> appeared<WH07200><WTH8735>, the foundations<WH04146> of the world<WH08398> were discovered<WH01540><WTH8735>, at the rebuking<WH01606> of the LORD<WH03068>, at the blast<WH05397> of the breath<WH07307> of his nostrils<WH0639>.
He sent<WH07971><WTH8799> from above<WH04791>, he took<WH03947><WTH8799> me; he drew<WH04871><WTH8686> me out of many<WH07227> waters<WH04325>; <RF>many: or, great<Rf>
He delivered<WH05337><WTH8686> me from my strong<WH05794> enemy<WH0341><WTH8802>, <FI>and<Fi> from them that hated<WH08130><WTH8802> me: for they were too strong<WH0553><WTH8804> for me.
They prevented<WH06923><WTH8762> me in the day<WH03117> of my calamity<WH0343>: but the LORD<WH03068> was my stay<WH04937>.
He brought me forth<WH03318><WTH8686> also into a large place<WH04800>: he delivered<WH02502><WTH8762> me, because he delighted<WH02654><WTH8804> in me.
The LORD<WH03068> rewarded<WH01580><WTH8799> me according to my righteousness<WH06666>: according to the cleanness<WH01252> of my hands<WH03027> hath he recompensed<WH07725><WTH8686> me.
For I have kept<WH08104><WTH8804> the ways<WH01870> of the LORD<WH03068>, and have not wickedly departed<WH07561><WTH8804> from my God<WH0430>.
For all his judgments<WH04941> <FI>were<Fi> before me: and <FI>as for<Fi> his statutes<WH02708>, I did not depart<WH05493><WTH8799> from them.
I was also upright<WH08549> before him, and have kept<WH08104><WTH8691> myself from mine iniquity<WH05771>. <RF>before: Heb. to<Rf>

Therefore the LORD<WH03068> hath recompensed<WH07725><WTH8686> me according to my righteousness<WH06666>; according to my cleanness<WH01252> in his eye sight<WH05048><WH05869>. <RF>in...: Heb. before his eyes<Rf>
With the merciful<WH02623> thou wilt shew thyself merciful<WH02616><WTH8691>, <FI>and<Fi> with the upright<WH08549> man<WH01368> thou wilt shew thyself upright<WH08552><WTH8691>.

With the pure<WH01305><WTH8737> thou wilt shew thyself pure<WH01305><WTH8691>; and with the froward<WH06141> thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury<WH06617><WTH8691>. <RF>shew thyself unsavoury: or, wrestle<Rf>

And the afflicted<WH06041> people<WH05971> thou wilt save<WH03467><WTH8686>: but thine eyes<WH05869> <FI>are<Fi> upon the haughty<WH07311><WTH8802>, <FI>that<Fi> thou mayest bring <FI>them<Fi> down<WH08213><WTH8686>.
For thou <FI>art<Fi> my lamp<WH05216>, O LORD<WH03068>: and the LORD<WH03068> will lighten<WH05050><WTH8686> my darkness<WH02822>. <RF>lamp: or, candle<Rf>
For by thee I have run<WH07323><WTH8799> through a troop<WH01416>: by my God<WH0430> have I leaped over<WH01801><WTH8762> a wall<WH07791>. <RF>run: or, broken<Rf>

<FI> As for<Fi> God<WH0410>, his way<WH01870> <FI>is<Fi> perfect<WH08549>; the word<WH0565> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> tried<WH06884><WTH8803>: he <FI>is<Fi> a buckler<WH04043> to all them that trust<WH02620><WTH8802> in him. <RF>tried: or, refined<Rf>
For who <FI>is<Fi> God<WH0410>, save<WH01107> the LORD<WH03068>? and who <FI>is<Fi> a rock<WH06697>, save<WH01107> our God<WH0430>?
God<WH0410> <FI>is<Fi> my strength<WH04581> <FI>and<Fi> power<WH02428>: and he maketh<WH05425><WTH8686> my way<WH01870> perfect<WH08549>. <RF>maketh: Heb. riddeth, or, looseth<Rf>
He maketh<WH07737><WH00> my feet<WH07272> like<WH07737><WTH8764> hinds<WH0355>' <FI>feet<Fi> : and setteth<WH05975><WTH8686> me upon my high places<WH01116>. <RF>maketh: Heb. equalleth<Rf>
He teacheth<WH03925><WTH8764> my hands<WH03027> to war<WH04421>; so that a bow<WH07198> of steel<WH05154> is broken<WH05181><WTH8765> by mine arms<WH02220>. <RF>to war: Heb. for the war<Rf>

Thou hast also given<WH05414><WTH8799> me the shield<WH04043> of thy salvation<WH03468>: and thy gentleness<WH06031><WTH8800><WTH8676><WH06038> hath made me great<WH07235><WTH8686>. <RF>made...: Heb. multiplied me<Rf>
Thou hast enlarged<WH07337><WTH8686> my steps<WH06806> under me; so that my feet<WH07166> did not slip<WH04571><WTH8804>. <RF>feet: Heb. ankles<Rf>
I have pursued<WH07291><WTH8799> mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, and destroyed<WH08045><WTH8686> them; and turned not again<WH07725><WTH8799> until I had consumed<WH03615><WTH8763> them.
And I have consumed<WH03615><WTH8762> them, and wounded<WH04272><WTH8799> them, that they could not arise<WH06965><WTH8799>: yea, they are fallen<WH05307><WTH8799> under my feet<WH07272>.

For thou hast girded<WH0247><WTH8762> me with strength<WH02428> to battle<WH04421>: them that rose up<WH06965><WTH8801> against me hast thou subdued<WH03766><WTH8686> under me. <RF>subdued: Heb. caused to bow<Rf>
Thou hast also given<WH05414><WTH8804> me the necks<WH06203> of mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, that I might destroy<WH06789><WTH8686> them that hate<WH08130><WTH8764> me.
They looked<WH08159><WTH8799>, but <FI>there was<Fi> none to save<WH03467><WTH8688>; <FI>even<Fi> unto the LORD<WH03068>, but he answered<WH06030><WTH8804> them not.

Then did I beat<WH07833><WTH8799> them as small as the dust<WH06083> of the earth<WH0776>, I did stamp<WH01854><WTH8686> them as the mire<WH02916> of the street<WH02351>, <FI>and<Fi> did spread them abroad<WH07554><WTH8799>.

Thou also hast delivered<WH06403><WTH8762> me from the strivings<WH07379> of my people<WH05971>, thou hast kept<WH08104><WTH8799> me <FI>to be<Fi> head<WH07218> of the heathen<WH01471>: a people<WH05971> <FI>which<Fi> I knew<WH03045><WTH8804> not shall serve<WH05647><WTH8799> me.

Strangers<WH01121><WH05236> shall submit<WH03584><WTH8691> themselves unto me: as soon as they hear<WH08085><WTH8800><WH0241>, they shall be obedient<WH08085><WTH8735> unto me. <RF>Strangers: Heb. Sons of the stranger<Rf> <RF>submit...: or, yield feigned obedience: Heb. lie<Rf>
Strangers<WH01121><WH05236> shall fade away<WH05034><WTH8799>, and they shall be afraid<WH02296><WTH8799> out of their close places<WH04526>.
The LORD<WH03068> liveth<WH02416>; and blessed<WH01288><WTH8803> <FI>be<Fi> my rock<WH06697>; and exalted<WH07311><WTH8799> be the God<WH0430> of the rock<WH06697> of my salvation<WH03468>.
It <FI>is<Fi> God<WH0410> that avengeth<WH05414><WTH8802><WH05360> me, and that bringeth down<WH03381><WTH8688> the people<WH05971> under me, <RF>avengeth: Heb. giveth avengement for<Rf>

And that bringeth me forth<WH03318><WTH8688> from mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>: thou also hast lifted me up on high<WH07311><WTH8787> above them that rose up<WH06965><WTH8801> against me: thou hast delivered<WH05337><WTH8686> me from the violent<WH02555> man<WH0376>.
Therefore I will give thanks<WH03034><WTH8686> unto thee, O LORD<WH03068>, among the heathen<WH01471>, and I will sing praises<WH02167><WTH8762> unto thy name<WH08034>.

<FI> He is<Fi> the tower<WH04024><WTH8675><WH01431><WTH8688> of salvation<WH03444> for his king<WH04428>: and sheweth<WH06213><WTH8802> mercy<WH02617> to his anointed<WH04899>, unto David<WH01732>, and to his seed<WH02233> for<WH05704> evermore<WH05769>.<CM>
